newsitem.title: UK: UK shares pulled higher by strong advance on Dow.
newsitem.headline: UK shares pulled higher by strong advance on Dow.

text.p: London shares closed slightly firmer on Monday with the support of strong gilts and a sharp advance on Wall Street, but renewed inflation and interest rate fears managed to sour sentiment for much of the day.

The FTSE 100 index was encouraged to the day's best levels by the unexpectedly sharp advance on Wall Street. The index finished up 3.6 points at 3,914.4 after trading in negative territory for most of the day.
Advancers and decliners were roughly evenly matched but trading volume was a slim 427 million shares, boosted by 7.4 million shares traded in penny stock Dana Petroleum.
